verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a search API, but nothing in the evidence pack documents a per-result relevance score field that a developer could read and threshold on. The closest item, tavily-docs-44, describes a latency-vs-relevance tradeoff control for how results[].content is generated, which is a different feature. Other filter controls (exact_match, safe_search, include_domains, max_age_hours) are also different features and earn no credit.
